metadata.description: Name of the Azure Log Analytics Workspace with Microsoft Sentinel enabled

properties.displayName: SecureShare — High Rate of Failed Authentication Attempts (Brute Force)
properties.description: Detects 5 or more failed login attempts from a single IP address within 5 minutes.
properties.query: SecureShare_Audit_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(5m) | where action_s in ('FAILED_LOGIN', 'LOGIN_FAILED') | summarize FailedCount = count(), Targets = make_set(username_s) by ip_address_s | where FailedCount >= 5

properties.description: Triggers an immediate Critical incident when malicious file signatures are detected during upload.
properties.query: SecureShare_Audit_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(10m) | where action_s == 'MALWARE_DETECTED' or status_s == 'ALERT'

properties.displayName: SecureShare — Suspected Mass Data Exfiltration Burst
properties.description: Detects 15 or more file downloads within 5 minutes from a single user or IP address.
properties.query: SecureShare_Audit_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(5m) | where action_s in ('FILE_DOWNLOAD', 'FILE_DOWNLOADED') and status_s == 'SUCCESS' | summarize Downloads = count() by username_s, ip_address_s | where Downloads >= 15

properties.displayName: SecureShare — Unauthorized Role Modification or Privilege Escalation
properties.description: Alerts when non-administrators attempt role modifications or when an administrative role change occurs.
properties.query: SecureShare_Audit_CL | where TimeGenerated >= ago(15m) | where action_s == 'ROLE_CHANGE' or (action_s == 'PERMISSION_DENIED' and resource_s contains 'role')
